about: meta QA 11-25 rows 82 and 119: script paths that point where nothing is, still carried, each with why its fix is not this repo's; shrink only (node .githooks/script-paths.mjs --prune).

findings.why: engine's src/scripts/parity/image-routes.mjs is engine-internal and @wildshard/sdk exports no such module; the import needs an SDK export first (sharddev's to add).
engine's src/scripts/parity/canvas-bytes.mjs is engine-internal and @wildshard/sdk exports no such module; the import needs an SDK export first (sharddev's to add).
The round-6 baseline HUD art (11 MB) stayed in singleplayer; this tool cannot run until its parity/ imports have an SDK export (the entries above), so the art comes across with that fix.

findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: The SDK's Blender build (node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh) reads its manifest at ./scripts/blender/targets.json from the repo root, and its nine-dragon-stack/fp-rig target builds a model here here; the folder moves under src/ when the SDK's build reads it there (sharddev's change).
